Welfare Implications of Electric Bike Subsidies: Evidence from Sweden
abstract: We evaluate a large-scale Swedish electric bike (E-bike) subsidy program in 2018, similar to those implemented in many other countries. We combine administrative, insurance and survey data to address challenges of welfare analyses such as non-additionality. We find (1) complete pass through of the average $494 subsidy to consumers, (2) a near doubling of E-bikes sold but one-third of the adopters are non-additional, and (3) a savings of 1.3 tons of carbon emissions during the life of the E-bike. At a cost of $589 per ton, the program is an expensive way to reduce carbon emissions from driving.
abstract_zh: 我们评估了瑞典于2018年实施的一项大规模电动自行车（E-bike）补贴计划，该计划与许多其他国家实施的计划相似。我们综合运用行政数据、保险数据和调查数据，以应对福利分析中的挑战，例如非附加性（non-additionality）问题。我们发现：（1）平均494美元的补贴被完全传导给了消费者；（2）电动自行车销量几乎翻倍，但三分之一的采用者属于非附加性采用者；（3）电动自行车在其使用寿命内可减少1.3吨碳排放。按每吨589美元的成本计算，该计划是减少驾车碳排放的一种昂贵方式。

title: Implications of Stochastic Transmission Rates for Managing Pandemic Risks

Mitigating Disaster Risks in the Age of Climate Change
abstract: Emissions abatement alone cannot address the consequences of global warming for weather disasters. We model how society adapts to manage disaster risks to capital stock. Optimal adaptation --- a mix of firm-level efforts and public spending --- varies as society learns about the adverse consequences of global warming for disaster arrivals. Taxes on capital are needed alongside those on carbon to achieve the first best. We apply our model to country-level control of flooding from tropical cyclones. Learning rationalizes empirical findings, including the responses of Tobin's q, equity risk premium, and risk-free rate to disaster arrivals. Adaptation is more valuable under learning than a counterfactual no-learning environment. Learning alters social-cost-of-carbon projections due to the interaction of uncertainty resolution and endogenous adaptive response.
abstract_zh: 仅靠减排无法应对全球变暖对天气灾害造成的后果。我们构建了一个模型，刻画社会如何适应并管理资本存量的灾害风险。最优适应方式，即企业层面的努力与公共支出的组合，会随着社会逐步认识到全球变暖对灾害发生的不利影响而变化。要实现第一最优，除了对碳征税外，还需要对资本征税。我们将该模型应用于国家层面的热带气旋洪水控制问题。学习机制能够合理解释若干实证发现，包括托宾q值、股权风险溢价和无风险利率对灾害发生的反应。与不存在学习的反事实环境相比，在学习机制下，适应措施更具价值。由于风险不确定性的消解与内生适应反应之间的相互作用，学习会改变社会碳成本的预测结果。

title: Reopening Effects of COVID-19 Vaccines on Corporate Earnings
Climate Finance
abstract: Climate finance is the study of local and global financing of public and private investment that seeks to support mitigation of and adaptation to climate change. In 2017, the Review of Financial Studies launched a competition among scholars to develop research proposals on the topic with the goal of publishing this special volume. We describe the competition, how the nine projects featured in this volume came to be published, and frame their findings within what we view as a broader climate finance research program.
abstract_zh: 气候金融研究的是为支持减缓和适应气候变化而进行的公共与私人投资的地方和全球融资问题。2017年，《金融研究评论》（Review of Financial Studies）发起了一项面向学者的竞赛，征集关于该主题的研究提案，目标是出版本期特刊。我们介绍了这一竞赛，以及本特刊所收录的九个项目是如何产生并得以出版的，并将其研究发现置于我们认为更为广泛的气候金融研究计划之中加以阐释。

title: Location Choice, Portfolio Choice
Climate Risks and Market Efficiency
abstract: We investigate whether stock markets efficiently price risks brought on or exacerbated by climate change. We focus on drought, the most damaging natural disaster for crops and food-company cash flows. We show that prolonged drought in a country, measured by the Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) from climate studies, forecasts both declines in profitability ratios and poor stock returns for food companies in that country.A portfolio short food stocks of countries in drought and long those of countries not in drought generates a 9.2% annualized return from 1985 to 2015.This excess predictability is larger in countries having little history of droughts prior to the 1980s.Our findings support regulatory concerns of markets inexperienced with climate change underreacting to such risks.
abstract_zh: 我们考察股票市场是否能够有效地为气候变化带来或加剧的风险定价。我们聚焦于干旱，它是对作物和食品企业现金流最具破坏性的自然灾害。我们表明，依据气候研究中的帕尔默干旱严重指数（PDSI）衡量的一个国家的长期干旱，既能预测该国食品企业盈利能力比率的下降，也能预测其较差的股票回报。从1985年到2015年，做空处于干旱国家的食品股、同时做多未处于干旱国家的食品股的投资组合，获得了9.2%的年化收益率。这种超额可预测性在20世纪80年代之前干旱历史较少的国家中更为显著。我们的研究结果支持了监管机构的担忧，即对气候变化缺乏经验的市场可能对此类风险反应不足。

Welfare Consequences of Sustainable Finance
abstract: We model the welfare consequences of portfolio mandates that restrict investors to hold firms with net-zero carbon emissions. To qualify for these mandates, value-maximizing firms have to accumulate decarbonization capital. Qualification lowers a firm’s required rate of return by its decarbonization investments divided by Tobin’s q, i.e., the dividend yield shareholders forgo to address the global-warming externality. The welfare-maximizing mandate approximates the first-best solution, yielding welfare gains compared to laissez faire by mitigating the weather disaster risks resulting from carbon emissions. Our model generates transitions to steady-state decarbonization-to-productive capital ratios that we use to evaluate the optimality of proposed net-zero targets.
abstract_zh: 我们建模分析了投资组合强制性要求的福利后果，这类要求限制投资者只能持有净零碳排放的企业。为了符合这些强制性要求，以价值最大化为目标的企业必须积累脱碳资本。符合条件会降低企业所要求的回报率，降低幅度等于其脱碳投资除以托宾q值，即股东为应对全球变暖外部性而放弃的股息收益率。福利最大化的强制性要求近似于第一最优解，与自由放任相比，它通过减轻碳排放所引发的天气灾害风险而带来福利增益。我们的模型生成了通往稳态的脱碳资本与生产性资本之比的转换路径，我们利用该路径评估所提出的净零排放目标的最优性。
